title: Authorized Personnel Only - How to Start and Sync a 400,000 Watt Turbine Hydroelectric Generator
summary: Chris Boden shows how an operator starts a large hydroelectric turbine generator and manually synchronizes it to the grid using a needle phase meter.
why: HN links it in power grid threads as a concrete demonstration of generator synchronization.

quote.text: Here's someone doing exactly that, synchronizing a medium-sized hydroelectric generator to the grid.[1]
